question_the_data_should_answer: Which facilities are leaking right now
evidence_for_the_gap: Sentinel-5P, GHGSat, Carbon Mapper, EMIT and IMEO MARS give near-global screening; EU Methane Regulation adds repair deadlines from 2025.

question_the_data_should_answer: What are the many small emitters below detection limit doing
evidence_for_the_gap: Satellite detection limits sit far above the per-source rate of distributed sources (small leaks, agriculture, domestic combustion); inventories fill the gap with modelled factors, not measurements.

question_the_data_should_answer: Was a detected leak actually fixed
evidence_for_the_gap: Partly revised: UNEP's satellite alert programme reports 40+ super-emitters curbed since 2023, and IEA Global Methane Tracker 2026 plus Nature Communications 2026 on super-emitter duration now quantify how long leaks persist. A response pathway exists; a public verified repair record still does not.
ERA5, Copernicus C3S, GOSAT, OCO, ground networks (ICOS). This is the best-observed layer in the whole chain.

question_the_data_should_answer: Will it be dangerously hot in three days
evidence_for_the_gap: C3S heat and health service, national met services, UTCI indices are operational across Europe.

question_the_data_should_answer: Which streets and neighbourhoods are hottest
observation_density: Medium in rich cities; low elsewhere
evidence_for_the_gap: Landsat/Sentinel-3 surface temperature is free but surface temperature is not air temperature; street-level air-temperature networks exist in dozens of European cities but were only made interoperable retrospectively by a 2026 compilation, and coverage is grant-dependent.

question_the_data_should_answer: How hot is it inside the room where a vulnerable person sleeps
evidence_for_the_gap: Still unmeasured at population scale in southern Europe, but 2026 pilots now exist elsewhere (City of Miami heat-sensor programme; Dutch crowdsourced indoor observations, QJRMS 2026; Boulder mobile homes, Environ. Res. Commun. 2026; New Zealand vulnerable households 2026). Feasibility is demonstrated; deployment and coupling are not.

question_the_data_should_answer: Who is where when it is hot
evidence_for_the_gap: Mobile-network presence data and vehicle-fleet ambient temperature telemetry exist commercially but are not fused with hazard data for public health. Blocker is governance not technology.

question_the_data_should_answer: Which specific individuals are at risk in this building tonight
who_can_see_it: Health and social services in silos
evidence_for_the_gap: Vulnerable-person registers exist in some municipalities but are rarely linked to live hazard feeds; identification of at-risk individuals is the recurring weak point in heat-plan evaluations.

question_the_data_should_answer: Do homes have shutters shading or reflective roofs
evidence_for_the_gap: EPBD energy performance certificates capture insulation and heating but external solar protection and summer overheating risk are weakly represented in most national certificate schemes.

question_the_data_should_answer: Is cooling available and affordable and being used
evidence_for_the_gap: Smart meters record the electrical signature of cooling at ~15-minute resolution for a majority of EU households, but the data is not used for heat-vulnerability detection.

question_the_data_should_answer: Did people receive understand and act on the warning
evidence_for_the_gap: Heat-plan evaluations repeatedly find that plans exist nearly everywhere yet mortality persists; the missing measurement is whether the last mile - individual receipt and action - happened at all.

question_the_data_should_answer: How many people died from this heatwave
evidence_for_the_gap: EuroMOMO gives weekly excess mortality and the 2024 Nature Medicine analysis quantified heat-related deaths, but the lag means outcome data cannot steer a live response - only post-hoc accountability.

question_the_data_should_answer: How many people were harmed but did not die
evidence_for_the_gap: Emergency-department and ambulance data are rarely syndromically linked to heat in near real time outside a few national systems.

question_the_data_should_answer: Did adaptation money reduce measured exposure
evidence_for_the_gap: Adaptation projects are almost never instrumented for before-and-after measurement of the exposure they were funded to reduce; monitoring budgets are capital-heavy and end with the project grant.
